en.title: HF Space: WepeNerd/ltx-ripple-demo
en.hook: An interactive Gradio demo showcasing ripple effects and video generation driven by LTX Video models.
key_takeaways: Web-based interactive interface built with Gradio SDK for LTX models.
Provides dynamic parameter tuning for video synthesis and visual ripple effects.
Serves as a lightweight prototype playground for fast video diffusion experiments.
